RPC_budget.log_requirement: Pre-reserve each bounded log stream once or buffer fixed64KiB; unbounded one-byte-per-read journaling is not covered
RPC_budget.source_rule: State constant18+72(nonempty)+2*(72ceil(head/512)+vectorrows); owned16; record4. Decode count<=charged rows. No comparison/read/finite check is removed.

accounting_rule: One global ledger; per-phase/per-request/per-worker caps intersect aggregate caps; reserved failure quota never supplies a runnable retry
admission_gaps: No approved GPU lease, new budget or five-hour window
Kernel cgroup body is source-only behind unconditional denial; no actual activation
Atomic clone3 domain launch not executed; no numeric-PID attach fallback
Full retained build/source selection is unmeasured
No native runtime peak/placement or numerical lifecycle evidence
CPU synthetic leases and ordinary-file limits grant no hardware authority

bridge_overhead.domain_snapshots: At most4096 bounded records in a bounded log, never one unbounded file per RPC

exclusions: model GGUF stays in independently identified existing model store
all unrelated historical worktrees and results

required_selection.role: fixed std-only CPU launcher and worker
frozen numeric archives/parser objects/dynamic library subset

build_selection.rule: Measure the exact selected files and resolved inodes; absent/oversize total blocks. No full historical buildtree is assumed to fit.

journal_rule: Broker and controller share the same512MiB journal ceiling; no second allowance
